note: Worked incrementally over months, not in one session. status field is the work queue.

strip_protocol.why: self-report is unreliable in BOTH directions for this corpus
strip_protocol.overwrite_1: status devaluation — holders were taught the knowledge marked them as primitive/broke. Retrieval fails even for the holder. Nostalgia reports the STATE, not the METHOD.
strip_protocol.overwrite_2: present-day reading imposed backward (esp. onto union material)
strip_protocol.overwrite_3: the era's own organizational self-presentation (solidarity framing was recruitment copy)
strip_protocol.rule: prefer PROCEDURE and RESIDUE over TESTIMONY. Bylaws, dues schedules, benefit administration records, inventories, terms sheets. Not accounts of how it felt.
strip_protocol.role_bindings: era assigned functions by sex and age. Role bindings are SUBSTITUTABLE SUBSTRATE — strip them. The function (contribution scheduling, rotation, gap coverage, small-scale fund solvency, transmission-by-doing) is the extraction target. Extract mechanism and ratios, drop role bindings. Same as reading branching rules off the lung without importing the lung.
strip_protocol.labor_note: what went into it was unpaid and largely women's and children's hours. Therefore residue sits where nothing was logged: kitchen equipment, storage volume, outbuildings. NOT in records or membership rolls.

PROCEDURAL.why: records HOW TO DO IT while it was working. Survives the status overwrite because it does not depend on anyone claiming the practice.

items.name: Foxfire books + Foxfire magazine archive
items.why: procedural interviews, not sentiment. Also captures SELF-CLASSIFICATION at the time (region considered itself middle, not poor) which is the part later rewritten. Contains the surplus mechanism: regional production competence with exportable margin — NOT frugality, NOT poverty adaptation.
